mentions.name: Blacklight
mentions.description: A pluggable secret and key scanner built from scratch that scans databases, file systems, and buckets for static keys and credentials, and lets users plug in new file types and parsers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have working on a pluggable secret and key scanner from scratch [1]

The idea is to build scanning databases, file systems, buckets, etc. for static keys and credentials while allowing users to add new file types and parsers.
